title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Shingles
intro: Herbal creams for Shingles are topical ointments made from natural herbs and plants, designed to alleviate the symptoms of shingles, a viral infection caused by the reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus. These creams have gained popularity due to their potential benefits, which include reducing pain, inflammation, and itching associated with shingles. Examples of herbal creams used to treat shingles include creams containing capsaicin, which helps to block pain signals, as well as creams infused with aloe vera, tea tree oil, and chamomile, which have anti-inflammatory and soothing properties. Other herbal creams used to treat shingles include those containing St. John's Wort, calendula, and comfrey, which are known for their antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties that can help to speed up the healing process and reduce the severity of symptoms.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams have been utilized as a natural remedy to alleviate the discomfort of shingles, a viral infection caused by the reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus. The anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce the severity of shingles symptoms, such as pain, itching, and blistering. The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis, including triterpenoids and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic effects by inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and promoting wound healing. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis creams to treat shingles include reduced inflammation, accelerated healing, and a decrease in the risk of postherpetic neuralgia, a common complication of shingles.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Calendula officinalis creams for shingles may be beneficial due to their extracts stimulating the proliferation and migration of fibroblasts, which can aid in wound healing.

By reducing inflammation and viral replication, Zingiber officinale creams can help to alleviate the discomfort and pain associated with shingles, promoting faster healing and reducing the risk of complications. The benefits of using Zingiber officinale creams to treat shingles include reduced pain and inflammation, accelerated healing, and a lower risk of postherpetic neuralgia, making it a promising natural remedy for this condition.
